## LmdbBackupStartOptions.persistKey property

Job name for the persisted stamp (default `'backup'`<!-- -->).

**Signature:**

```typescript
persistKey?: string;
```

## Remarks

Use distinct names for schedules sharing one env, so they do not overwrite each other's stamp.
